"""Cal.com scheduling platform manifest.

Open-source scheduling infrastructure for everyone.
A Turborepo TypeScript monorepo offering a full-featured Calendly
alternative with a Next.js/tRPC web app and a NestJS platform API.

Architecture reference: https://github.com/calcom/cal.com
Source: https://github.com/calcom/cal.com
"""

from scryr.manifest import Diagram, Link, Manifest
from scryr.saas import Classification
from scryr.types import (
    AuthType,
    CICDToolType,
    DeploymentTarget,
    IaCToolType,
    LogAggregationType,
    MonitoringType,
    ProgrammingLanguage,
    TracingType,
    Url,
    WebFramework,
    parse_version,
)

_SOURCE = Url("https://github.com/calcom/cal.com")
_DOCS = Url("https://cal.com/docs")
_CICD = CICDToolType.github_actions
_IAC = IaCToolType.none
_MONITOR = MonitoringType.none
_LOGS = LogAggregationType.none
_TRACING = TracingType.none
postgres_block = Manifest(
    name="PostgreSQL",
    icon="🐘",
    classification=Classification.database,
    tags=["database", "sql", "infra"],
    connections=[],
    description="Primary relational database storing all cal.com data: users, bookings, event types, availability rules, and workflows. Accessed exclusively via Prisma ORM.",
    version=parse_version("15.0.0"),
    language=ProgrammingLanguage.sql,
    deployment=DeploymentTarget.render,
    owner_team="Platform",
    auth_type=AuthType.basic,
    monitoring=_MONITOR,
    log_aggregation=_LOGS,
    tracing=_TRACING,
    iac_tool=_IAC,
    max_replicas=2,
    min_replicas=1,
    links=[Link(site_name="Cal.com Docs", http_url=_DOCS)],
    repo_url=_SOURCE,
    cicd_tool=_CICD,
)
redis_block = Manifest(
    name="Redis",
    icon="🔴",
    classification=Classification.cache_store,
    tags=["cache", "rate-limiting", "infra"],
    connections=[],
    description="In-memory cache and rate-limit store (Upstash or self-hosted). Used for caching availability calculations and API rate limiting.",
    version=parse_version("7.0.0"),
    language=ProgrammingLanguage.c,
    deployment=DeploymentTarget.render,
    owner_team="Platform",
    auth_type=AuthType.api_key,
    monitoring=_MONITOR,
    log_aggregation=_LOGS,
    tracing=_TRACING,
    iac_tool=_IAC,
    max_replicas=1,
    min_replicas=1,
    links=[Link(site_name="Cal.com Docs", http_url=_DOCS)],
    repo_url=_SOURCE,
    cicd_tool=_CICD,
)
web_block = Manifest(
    name="Web App",
    icon="📅",
    classification=Classification.public_ui,
    tags=["frontend", "scheduling", "monolith"],
    connections=["PostgreSQL", "Redis", "Email", "Daily.co", "Workflow Cron"],
    description="Main Next.js application serving the cal.com scheduling UI and tRPC backend. Handles booking flows, event types, availability, user auth (NextAuth.js), calendar integrations, Prisma data access, and outbound webhooks.",
    version=parse_version("6.2.0"),
    language=ProgrammingLanguage.typescript,
    frameworks=[WebFramework.nextjs],
    deployment=DeploymentTarget.vercel,
    owner_team="Product",
    auth_type=AuthType.oauth2,
    monitoring=_MONITOR,
    log_aggregation=_LOGS,
    tracing=_TRACING,
    iac_tool=_IAC,
    max_replicas=10,
    min_replicas=2,
    links=[
        Link(site_name="Cal.com", http_url=Url("https://cal.com")),
        Link(site_name="Source", http_url=_SOURCE),
    ],
    repo_url=_SOURCE,
    cicd_tool=_CICD,
)
api_v2_block = Manifest(
    name="API v2",
    icon="🔌",
    classification=Classification.public_api,
    tags=["api", "platform", "headless"],
    connections=["PostgreSQL", "Redis"],
    description="NestJS REST API for the Cal.com Platform offering (Cal Atoms). Provides headless scheduling endpoints so third-party developers can embed cal.com booking experiences into their own products.",
    version=parse_version("2.0.0"),
    language=ProgrammingLanguage.typescript,
    frameworks=[WebFramework.nestjs],
    deployment=DeploymentTarget.vercel,
    owner_team="Platform",
    auth_type=AuthType.api_key,
    monitoring=_MONITOR,
    log_aggregation=_LOGS,
    tracing=_TRACING,
    iac_tool=_IAC,
    max_replicas=5,
    min_replicas=1,
    links=[
        Link(
            site_name="API v2 Reference",
            http_url=Url("https://cal.com/docs/api-reference/v2/introduction"),
        )
    ],
    repo_url=_SOURCE,
    cicd_tool=_CICD,
)
email_block = Manifest(
    name="Email",
    icon="✉️",
    classification=Classification.public_api,
    tags=["email", "notifications", "transactional"],
    connections=[],
    description="Transactional email service (SendGrid) that delivers booking confirmations, cancellations, reschedule requests, team invitations, and workflow-triggered reminders to attendees and organizers.",
    version=parse_version("1.0.0"),
    language=ProgrammingLanguage.typescript,
    deployment=DeploymentTarget.vercel,
    owner_team="Product",
    auth_type=AuthType.api_key,
    monitoring=_MONITOR,
    log_aggregation=_LOGS,
    tracing=_TRACING,
    iac_tool=_IAC,
    max_replicas=1,
    min_replicas=1,
    links=[Link(site_name="Cal.com Docs", http_url=_DOCS)],
    repo_url=_SOURCE,
    cicd_tool=_CICD,
)
workflow_cron_block = Manifest(
    name="Workflow Cron",
    icon="⏰",
    classification=Classification.scheduler,
    tags=["cron", "workflows", "automation"],
    connections=["PostgreSQL", "Email"],
    description="Vercel cron-based job runner that processes automated cal.com workflows: scheduled email and SMS reminders (via Twilio), booking follow-ups, expired booking cleanup, and daily digest jobs.",
    version=parse_version("1.0.0"),
    language=ProgrammingLanguage.typescript,
    deployment=DeploymentTarget.vercel,
    owner_team="Product",
    auth_type=AuthType.api_key,
    monitoring=_MONITOR,
    log_aggregation=_LOGS,
    tracing=_TRACING,
    iac_tool=_IAC,
    max_replicas=1,
    min_replicas=1,
    links=[Link(site_name="Cal.com Docs", http_url=_DOCS)],
    repo_url=_SOURCE,
    cicd_tool=_CICD,
)
daily_video_block = Manifest(
    name="Daily.co",
    icon="📹",
    classification=Classification.public_api,
    tags=["video", "conferencing", "integration"],
    connections=[],
    description="Embedded video conferencing provider powering Cal Video — the built-in video call option for bookings. Rooms are created and managed via the Daily REST API.",
    version=parse_version("1.0.0"),
    language=ProgrammingLanguage.javascript,
    deployment=DeploymentTarget.unknown,
    owner_team="Product",
    auth_type=AuthType.api_key,
    monitoring=_MONITOR,
    log_aggregation=_LOGS,
    tracing=_TRACING,
    iac_tool=_IAC,
    max_replicas=1,
    min_replicas=1,
    links=[Link(site_name="Daily Docs", http_url=Url("https://docs.daily.co/reference"))],
    repo_url=Url("https://github.com/daily-co/daily-js"),
    cicd_tool=CICDToolType.none,
)
app_store_block = Manifest(
    name="App Store",
    icon="🧩",
    classification=Classification.sdk,
    tags=["integrations", "calendars", "payments"],
    connections=["PostgreSQL", "Web App"],
    description="Cal.com App Store — a collection of OAuth2 and API-key integrations: Google Calendar, Outlook, Zoom, Stripe, HubSpot, Salesforce, Zapier, and 100+ more. Each app is a self-contained package in packages/app-store.",
    version=parse_version("1.0.0"),
    language=ProgrammingLanguage.typescript,
    deployment=DeploymentTarget.vercel,
    owner_team="Product",
    auth_type=AuthType.oauth2,
    monitoring=_MONITOR,
    log_aggregation=_LOGS,
    tracing=_TRACING,
    iac_tool=_IAC,
    max_replicas=1,
    min_replicas=1,
    links=[Link(site_name="App Store", http_url=Url("https://app.cal.com/apps"))],
    repo_url=_SOURCE,
    cicd_tool=_CICD,
)

calcom_diagram = Diagram(
    name="Cal.com",
    manifests=[
        postgres_block,
        redis_block,
        web_block,
        api_v2_block,
        email_block,
        workflow_cron_block,
        daily_video_block,
        app_store_block,
    ],
)

calcom_booking_flow_diagram = Diagram(
    name="Cal.com Booking Flow",
    manifests=[
        web_block,
        postgres_block,
        redis_block,
        email_block,
        workflow_cron_block,
        daily_video_block,
    ],
)
